plugin.name: Odin - Mysticism - Adamant Patch (ESL)
plugin.description:
Comprehensive compatibility patch for Odin, Mysticism, and Adamant.
Features: - Restores Simonrim & Adamant perk hook effects (MAG_PerkResolve, reanimate bonuses, cloak perks, Dragonhide hooks) on all 353 conflicting vanilla records. - Deduplicates spell tomes from vendor and loot distribution (removes 17 duplicate spells from Odin's runtime injection formlists). - Forwards Simonrim keywords (Sun damage, Poison damage, Circle spells) to Odin's unique spells for full perk scaling. - Flagged as ESL (0 load order slots).
Auto-Detection Status: This option is automatically checked (Recommended) if Odin, Mysticism, and Adamant are active in your load order.
Required Masters & Versions: - Odin - Skyrim Magic Overhaul.esp (v3.2.0+) - MysticismMagic.esp (v2.5.0+) - Adamant.esp (v6.0.4+) - Skyrim.esm - Update.esm - Dawnguard.esm - HearthFires.esm - Dragonborn.esm
